l4_steps.name: Extract booked passenger manifest from PSS
l4_steps.input: T-96h scheduler trigger; confirmed PNR bookings
l4_steps.output: Passenger manifest with PNR, contact details, flight segments
l4_steps.kpi: Manifest extraction latency ≤15 min from trigger; data completeness ≥99.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa API rate limits during peak booking windows can delay manifest pull by 30–45 min, pushing communications outside the optimal 72h window

l4_steps.name: Enrich profiles with loyalty tier & preferences
l4_steps.input: Passenger manifest from Step 1.1; Rapid Rewards member IDs
l4_steps.output: Enriched passenger profile: loyalty tier, seat preference, meal code, language, preferred channel
l4_steps.kpi: Profile match rate ≥95% against CRM records; enrichment processing ≤10 min per 10,000 records
l4_steps.pain_point: Non-member or pseudonymous bookings via OTA channels lack Rapid Rewards linkage, resulting in generic (non-personalised) communication for ~18% of bookings

l4_steps.name: Validate communication consent & channel eligibility
l4_steps.input: Enriched passenger profiles; GDPR/CAN-SPAM opt-in records
l4_steps.output: Suppression list; approved channel map (email / SMS / push) per passenger
l4_steps.kpi: Opt-out suppression accuracy 100%; consent validation completed ≤5 min before send queue
l4_steps.pain_point: Consent records stored in multiple systems (PSS, CRM, mobile app) can be out of sync; GDPR Article 7 requires unambiguous consent — mismatch risk if unified consent hub is absent

l4_steps.name: Build personalised comms cadence schedule
l4_steps.input: Approved channel map; departure date/time per PNR
l4_steps.output: Communication schedule: T-72h, T-24h, T-4h, and day-of touchpoints per passenger
l4_steps.kpi: Schedule build time ≤20 min for full departure manifest; ≥98% of schedules created before T-72h window
l4_steps.pain_point: Multi-leg itineraries with short connections require independent cadence per leg; logic errors in connection-aware scheduling have caused duplicate or mis-timed notifications

l4_steps.name: Generate dynamic itinerary & ancillary offer content
l4_steps.input: Passenger profile; flight data (route, aircraft type, departure time, gate if assigned)
l4_steps.output: Personalised HTML/text email body; SMS template; push notification payload
l4_steps.kpi: Content personalisation token fill rate ≥99%; render error rate ≤0.1% across email clients
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate and terminal data is often unavailable at T-72h for airports operating under dynamic gate assignment (e.g., Midway MDW), forcing placeholder text that reduces perceived communication quality

l4_steps.name: Validate dynamic content against live flight data
l4_steps.input: Draft communication content; live PNR and schedule data
l4_steps.output: Validated content batch; list of records with stale data flagged for re-fetch
l4_steps.kpi: Data staleness rate ≤0.5% at send time; validation cycle ≤8 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Schedule changes filed in Altéa after content generation but before send can produce communications with incorrect departure times — requires a final data refresh check within 30 min of send

l4_steps.name: Run GDPR / CAN-SPAM compliance check on content
l4_steps.output: Compliance-approved send batch; rejected items routed back to content team
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of sends include mandatory unsubscribe link; compliance check completion ≤5 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Transactional vs marketing classification is disputed for upsell content (e.g., ancillary offers embedded in itinerary emails); misclassification exposes airline to CAN-SPAM violation — legal review required per campaign type

l4_steps.name: Send 72h check-in invitation with OLCI link
l4_steps.input: Compliance-approved send batch; OLCI deep link from Amadeus Altéa DCS
l4_steps.output: Email / SMS / push notification delivered; delivery receipt logged
l4_steps.kpi: Email open rate ≥45%; SMS delivery rate ≥98%; OLCI click-through rate ≥35%
l4_steps.pain_point: Online check-in opens at T-24h for some fare classes (e.g., Basic Economy restrictions); sending OLCI link at T-72h for ineligible passengers creates customer confusion and misdirected contact centre calls

l4_steps.name: Deliver ancillary upsell offers — seat, baggage, lounge
l4_steps.input: Loyalty tier; current booking ancillary status from Amadeus Altéa PSS; pricing from ATPCO
l4_steps.output: Personalised offer email with real-time ancillary pricing; offer acceptance tracked in CRM
l4_steps.kpi: Ancillary revenue per communication ≥$4.50; offer acceptance rate ≥8%; unsubscribe rate ≤0.2%
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO ancillary pricing updates can lag real-time seat inventory, resulting in offers quoting prices that have since changed — requires live price validation at click-through, not at send time

l4_steps.name: Send travel readiness advisory — docs, visa, weather
l4_steps.input: Destination country; passenger nationality; IATA Travel Centre visa data; NWS / Weather API feed
l4_steps.output: Travel advisory notification including document requirements, TSA PreCheck reminder, weather summary
l4_steps.kpi: Advisory delivery ≥ T-48h before departure; advisory relevance score ≥4.2/5 in post-trip survey
l4_steps.pain_point: International routes to Mexico and Caribbean require ESTA / visa data that is sourced from IATA Travel Centre; data freshness is ±24h — incorrect requirements issued to passengers have led to denied-boarding incidents and liability claims

l4_steps.name: Confirm check-in status and deliver boarding pass
l4_steps.input: Completed OLCI session; seat assignment; SSR codes (wheelchair, UMNR, etc.)
l4_steps.output: Mobile boarding pass (PKPass / Google Wallet); check-in confirmation with seat and gate (if known)
l4_steps.kpi: Mobile boarding pass adoption rate ≥72%; boarding pass delivery latency ≤30 sec post check-in
l4_steps.pain_point: PKPass wallet integration with Altéa DCS has known compatibility gaps for codeshare itineraries — passengers on partner-operated segments occasionally receive blank boarding passes, requiring airport reprint

l4_steps.name: Monitor real-time flight status for schedule changes
l4_steps.input: Live OPS data feed from SITA AMS; ATC slot updates; weather NOTAMs via Jeppesen FliteDeck
l4_steps.output: Continuous status stream flagging delays, gate changes, cancellations per flight
l4_steps.kpi: Flight status event latency ≤2 min from OPS system to comms trigger; monitoring uptime ≥99.9%
l4_steps.pain_point: SITA AMS and Altéa PSS publish flight status updates independently; reconciliation lag between the two systems (up to 8 min) can result in duplicate or conflicting passenger notifications

l4_steps.name: Detect IROPS threshold breach and raise alert
l4_steps.input: Flight status stream from Step 4.1; IROPS threshold parameters (delay >30 min, gate change, cancellation)
l4_steps.output: IROPS event record; passenger impact list; notification trigger sent to comms platform
l4_steps.kpi: IROPS detection-to-trigger latency ≤3 min; false positive alert rate ≤1%
l4_steps.pain_point: Threshold parameters are configured statically — a 25-min delay that extends to 90 min in increments may not trigger the 30-min rule until too late, leaving passengers uninformed during the critical re-booking window

l4_steps.name: Send gate change, delay or cancellation notification
l4_steps.input: IROPS event record; passenger contact details; new gate/ETD or cancellation flag
l4_steps.output: Push/SMS/email alert delivered; delivery confirmation logged in Salesforce CRM
l4_steps.kpi: First notification delivered ≤5 min of IROPS trigger; SMS delivery rate ≥99%; passenger awareness rate ≥90% (tracked via boarding rate post-alert)
l4_steps.pain_point: Airport-side gate change displays (FIDS) and passenger SMS notifications are not synchronised — passengers often receive gate-change SMS after the FIDS has already shown the new gate, eroding trust in the notification system

l4_steps.name: Generate and deliver rebooking options for cancelled flights
l4_steps.input: Cancellation event; passenger PNR; available alternative flights; loyalty tier (for priority rebooking)
l4_steps.output: Personalised rebooking offer email/SMS with up to 3 flight alternatives; compensation voucher if applicable; self-service rebooking link
l4_steps.kpi: Rebooking offer delivered ≤10 min of cancellation confirmation; self-service rebooking rate ≥55%; contact centre deflection rate ≥40%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa availability query during IROPS events is throttled due to simultaneous mass rebooking — alternative availability returned to passengers can be stale within 90 sec, leading to 'flight no longer available' errors at checkout and escalated call volumes
